full_prompt_en: A square expressive oil portrait shows a man's face and upper shoulder in close three-quarter view, built from broad fragmented brush strokes against a pale gray ground. His head occupies the left and center, cropped at the forehead and below the collar, with the right side opening to a broad empty field. A dark block of short hair descends from the top edge, and one ear projects strongly at the left. The face turns toward the right and slightly downward. A pronounced nose, dark mustache and beard stubble, and deeply shadowed eye socket emerge from overlapping planes of lavender gray, cream, peach, charcoal, and muted blue. The nearer cheek catches a pale warm highlight, while the jaw and neck are assembled from heavier blue-black strokes. A dark jacket collar cuts across the lower left, its sharp angular marks contrasting with softer skin planes. The image deliberately leaves some facial boundaries incomplete: background gray shows between strokes, and scraper-like smears cross the brow and cheek. Paint has a dry, thick, worked surface, with rectangular swipes and abrupt color changes rather than smooth anatomical blending. Light seems to strike from the upper right, catching the bridge of the nose and cheek while the eye and underside of the jaw stay in cool shadow. The pale background remains spare, marked by a few faint drips and linear traces but no objects or writing. The overall composition is austere and intense, using a dense cropped head against large negative space to turn broken paint into convincing volume.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现性油画肖像呈现一名男子的脸与上肩，取贴近的四分之三侧面，以宽阔破碎笔触构成，背景是浅灰色。他的头占据左侧和中央，额头上方与衣领下方被画框裁断，右侧留出宽阔空域。一块深色短发从上沿垂下，一只耳朵在左侧明显突出。脸朝右并微微向下。突出的鼻子、深色胡须与下巴胡茬、深陷眼窝从薰衣草灰、奶油、桃色、炭黑和柔和蓝色的重叠平面中浮现。近侧脸颊接住浅暖亮光，下颌与脖颈由更沉重的蓝黑笔痕拼成。深色夹克领口横过左下方，尖锐棱角笔痕与较柔和肤色平面形成对照。图像有意让部分面部边界不完整：背景灰从笔触间露出，刮刀般的拖痕横过眉与脸颊。颜料表面干燥、厚实、反复加工，以矩形扫笔和突然变色取代光滑解剖渐层。光似乎从右上方击中鼻梁与脸颊，眼睛和下颌下方留在冷影里。浅背景保持简少，只有几条淡流痕与线迹，没有物件或文字。整体构图简峻而强烈，以密实紧裁的头部对照大面积负空间，让破碎颜料构成可信体积。
style_prompt_en: Expressive oil painting constructs volume from thick rectangular strokes, scraped gaps, and abrupt planes of cream, slate blue, lavender gray, peach, and charcoal. Some edges lock into sharp angles while others fragment into a pale unpainted ground, preserving the act of making. Warm light occupies a few central planes; cool shadows deepen under projections and at the lower edge. Detail is concentrated in a compact focal mass, with broad quiet space around it. The result is rough yet coherent, sculptural, and emotionally intense.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性油画用厚实矩形笔触、刮开的空隙，以及奶油色、石板蓝、薰衣草灰、桃色和炭色的突变平面构造体积。一些边缘咬合成尖锐角度，另一些破碎进浅色未画底面，保留制作行为痕迹。暖光占据少数中央平面，冷影在突出部下方和下缘变深。细节集中在紧凑焦点色团，周围是宽阔安静空间。效果粗犷却连贯、有雕塑感且情绪强烈。
theme_en: A man's face built from broad fragmented brush strokes
theme_zh: 一张由宽阔破碎笔触构成的男子面孔
name: Ryan Hewett
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
